title: Studio Colour Chart (calibration plate)
description: Reference calibration plate: 24 colour patches, a 21-step greyscale ramp and corner registration marks. Every pixel is placed arithmetically by seed/scripts/authored_plates.py — no generative model is involved anywhere in it, which is what makes its `none` declaration a statement of fact rather than a disclaimer.

title: Reference Mood Board (AI plate + authored swatches)
description: Mood board: the left panel is one of the in-house Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large plates, the palette strip beside it is sampled from that plate's own pixels, and the swatch grid, rules and registration marks are drawn by seed/scripts/authored_plates.py. Part of the work came out of a generative model and part did not, so neither `generated` nor `none` would be true of it — this is the middle state.
